dimensions.assessment: Directly affects veterans residing in the Freely Associated States and Department of Veterans Affairs personnel.
dimensions.evidence: furnish to veterans in the Freely Associated States services that include, at a minimum-- health services provided by telehealth; and pharmaceutical products delivered by mail.

dimensions.assessment: Provides tangible healthcare, pharmacy delivery, and travel reimbursement benefits to targeted veterans who previously may not have received them locally.
dimensions.evidence: If, with respect to any fiscal year, the Secretary exercises the authority under this section to make any payments, the Secretary shall make the payments provided for

dimensions.assessment: Requires quarterly reports on implementation costs, but the source text does not specify exact aggregate dollar amounts.
dimensions.evidence: submit to the appropriate committees of Congress a report on the implementation of this section and the cost of such implementation.

dimensions.assessment: Directs specific administrative actions, agreement negotiations, and mandatory benefit inclusions (telehealth, mail-order pharmacy, travel) for a defined geographic region.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall furnish to veterans in the Freely Associated States services that include, at a minimum-- health services provided by telehealth; and pharmaceutical products delivered by mail.

dimensions.assessment: Mandates permanent service obligations following implementation deadlines within one year of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: begin furnishing the services required by paragraphs (1) and (2) of subsection (b) not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Total projected financial cost or budget allocation for providing these health services and travel payments.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to establish agreements, telehealth services, mail-order pharmacy products, and travel payments for veterans living in the Freely Associated States, accompanied by regular congressional reports.
